name: compliance-theater-2000
description: Rich education compliance analysis support for Codex, including authenticated MCP access to policy, evidence, and compliance workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Compliance analysis and resources for education.
interface.longDescription: Rich education compliance analysis support for Codex, including authenticated MCP access to policy, evidence, and compliance workflows.
defaultPrompt: List Compliance Theater 2000's available tools and resources.
Load case file document id <case_id> and summarize it.

settings.name: targetServerUrl
settings.label: Compliance Theater URL
settings.description: MCP SSE endpoint. Use the hosted default, or http://localhost:3000/api/ai/tools/sse for local development.

settings.name: clientSecret
settings.label: OAuth client secret
settings.description: Optional OAuth client secret for confidential clients. Store this in Codex secure plugin settings rather than config.toml.

settings.name: logFile
settings.label: Wrapper log file
settings.description: Optional path for MCP wrapper diagnostics. Defaults to ~/.codex/mcp-resource-auth/compliance-theater-wrapper.log.
